summary.text: Andrew Lang is the Republican incumbent state senator for Minnesota State Senate District 16 and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot for re-election.

He is a U.S. Army National Guard soldier and emergency air transport pilot who was first elected to the Senate in 2016, and the Minnesota Senate's member directory lists Andrew R. Lang as a Republican representing District 16.

paragraphs.text: Andrew Lang graduated from Crookston High School in 2001 and began serving in the U.S. Army National Guard in 2005, reaching the rank of Battalion Senior Human Resources Sergeant as of 2023.
He earned an associate degree from Ridgewater College and a B.S. from St. Cloud State University, and his career experience includes working as an emergency air transport pilot with the U.S. Army.
Lang won the 2016 election for Minnesota State Senate District 17, defeating incumbent Lyle Koenen with 57.29 percent of the vote.
He was re-elected in District 17 in 2020, defeating Fernando Alvarado, and again in 2022 in District 16, where he defeated Alvarado with 69.7 percent of the vote.
Ballotpedia lists his Senate tenure as beginning in 2017, with his current term ending in 2027.

In 2025-2026 Lang was assigned to the Education Finance Committee, the Environment and Natural Resources Policy and Legacy Finance Committee, the Local Government Committee, where he is the ranking minority member, and the Senate Transportation Finance and Policy Committee.
Earlier, he chaired the Veterans and Military Affairs Finance and Policy Committee in 2021-2022.
His 2026 Republican primary was canceled, and Kathy Jorgenson is the Democratic candidate in the general election.
